biography.ja: 現在のリトアニア、ヴィリニュスに生まれ、モニューシコに師事した。本業は軍事技術者であり、要塞建築の専門家として陸軍士官学校で長年教鞭を執りながら、余暇に作曲活動を続けた。バラキレフを中心とする「五人組」の一員として、ムソルグスキーやリムスキー=コルサコフ、ボロディンらと行動を共にした。
biography.en: Born in what is now Vilnius, Lithuania, he studied under Moniuszko. His primary profession was as a military engineer, and he taught for many years at a military academy as a specialist in fortification while continuing to compose in his spare time. As a member of "The Five," led by Balakirev, he was active alongside Mussorgsky, Rimsky-Korsakov, and Borodin.

style.ja: 「五人組」の理念に沿ってロシア的な色彩を重視した作風を持つが、他の四人に比べると西欧的な洗練された旋律感覚を強く保ち続けた。音楽評論家としても精力的に活動し、自らのグループの主張を新聞・雑誌で擁護する論客としての役割も果たした。
style.en: In line with the ideals of "The Five," his style emphasizes Russian color, though compared to the other four members he retained a stronger sense of Western European melodic refinement. He was also energetically active as a music critic, playing the role of a vocal advocate defending his group's ideas in newspapers and journals.

impact.ja: 作曲家としての実作面ではバラキレフやムソルグスキー、リムスキー=コルサコフ、ボロディンら他の四人ほどの知名度を得られなかったが、評論家としてグループの理念を広く発信した功績は大きく、「五人組」という名称の定着そのものに深く関わった人物である。軍事技術者と作曲家という異色の二重生活は、19世紀ロシアにおけるアマチュア作曲家の存在感を象徴している。
impact.en: As a composer in his own right, he did not achieve the same renown as the other four members, Balakirev, Mussorgsky, Rimsky-Korsakov, and Borodin, but his contribution as a critic who broadly disseminated the group's ideals was significant, and he was deeply involved in establishing the very name "The Five." His unusual double life as a military engineer and composer symbolizes the presence of the amateur composer within nineteenth-century Russian musical life.
